Module geo_type

The module consists of two classes, GeoType for modeling a base type, and CompoundGeoType for modeling a compound type.

Classes
  GeoType
A GeoType models a base geography type.
  CompoundGeoType
A CompoundGeoType models a compound geography type that consists of several subtypes.
